title: Build dual-threaded LynxJS native mobile UI with main-thread gestures and recycled lists

contextSnapshot.surface: mobile product feed with interactive drag-to-scrub card and waterfall gallery

prompt: Implement a LynxJS product feed with a smooth drag gesture and long scrollable gallery on iOS and Android without frame drops.
forbiddenBehaviors: uses browser HTML tags like <div>/<span> or document.querySelector in native Lynx components
routes per-pixel touchmove gesture animations through background React state instead of main-thread scripting
renders hundreds of unrecycled items in scroll-view instead of <list> and <list-item>

rubricDimensions.pass: uses 'main thread' directive, useMainThreadRef, and main-thread:bind* for continuous gestures while keeping business logic on the background thread
rubricDimensions.fail: round-trips every touchmove frame through background React setState

rubricDimensions.pass: uses <view>, <text>, <image>, and <list>/<list-item item-key=...> with real CSS tokens
rubricDimensions.fail: writes browser DOM code or unrecycled scroll-view loops

rubricDimensions.pass: honors safe areas, text scaling, and platform navigation gestures
rubricDimensions.fail: clips scaled text in fixed-height containers

negativeControls.name: background-thread drag loop
negativeControls.input: call setState(e.detail.y) inside background bindtouchmove on every pointer tick
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend background-thread React state updates for per-frame drag physics in LynxJS

negativeControls.name: browser dom in lynx
negativeControls.mustNot: assume browser DOM APIs exist in native LynxJS targets

baseline.withoutSkill: writes standard web React DOM tags, drives drag gestures via background setState, and omits <list> recycling
baseline.withSkill: uses Lynx native primitives, main-thread gesture scripting, recycled <list-item> keys, and mobile safe-area/type scaling
